race.comment: DIAMOND LUCY (9) is in good form, having won a 3yo+ Class 3 at Bowen by just under a length and she is already proven at this track and distance. Can repeat the dose. HELL OF A BENTLEY (4) is the main danger after a one-length third at this track on soft ground. Has third-up fitness in his favour, though he is still chasing a first 1200m win. CERETTI (12) comes off a clear-cut Maiden win at Bowen and has the right profile, but she is new to this venue and steps back into a deeper race. Watch the markets. TSUNAMI (5) has been racing consistently, gets weight relief and his previous track-and-distance win keeps him in the mix.
